name: World Map Engine
author: ct
description: Engine world map subsystem: the full-screen map overlay (MapWidget), polygon zones layer, markers, the zone list + runtime override singleton, the scenario-facing map service facade with the open/close/show/hide scenario actions, and the shared zone style and enterability rules. Replaces the former Core/UI/Tool Map* implementations and Core/Actions/MapZoneServiceImpl. The save-format DTO MapZoneStateData stays in the core because RuntimeSerializer owns the __core__ slot layout; the mod plugs into it through MapStateBridge.
